call_points.text: Capacity utilisation was 82-87% in FY26, with Dahej in a similar range.
Own manufactured products were 42% of FY26 sales, merchandise 58%.
Agri solutions market share is around 7%, up from 3% a few years back.
FY26 revenue growth of 1.3% split into 5.9% volume growth and a 4.6% price decrease.
Management explicitly does not provide any forecast or guidance on future results or business outlook.
Celasto expansion building is complete; the line is targeted to go live by end of this year.
call_points.versus_prior: Building phase completed in May 2026; now targeting line commissioning by end-2026

call_points.text: Higher feedstock costs from the Iran war are being passed on with a time lag; success varies by segment.
Management expects a slight softening of demand, with some wait-and-see mode in industrial sectors.
Agricultural Solutions demerger: SEBI and exchanges cleared on 2 February 2026; shareholder meeting on 24 June 2026.
call_points.versus_prior: Shareholder meeting scheduled for 24 June 2026, as previously indicated

call_points.text: Chinese oversupply and global overcapacities are pressuring chemical margins, especially in upstream businesses.
Cellasto capacity enhancement at Dahej completed building phase in May 2026.
Demerger of Agricultural Solutions business on track with shareholder meeting scheduled for June 24, 2026.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The Company had availed CENVAT credit of Service tax on inputs, input services and capital goods used in the course of setting up of factory. The department had raised Show Cause Notice raising tax demand of INR 27.75 crores along with penalty equivalent to the tax for the period from April 11 to March 16. The department alleged that the definition of 'input services' has been amended w.e.f. 01 April, 2011 to exclude Service Tax credit in relation to any services used in connection with setting up of factory. The demand is set aside from CESTAT & matter is remanded back to the Adjudicating Authority (Additional Commissioner)
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Adjudicating Authority (Additional Commissioner) post remand back
tax_litigation.status: The office of Commissioner of Central GST & Central Excise, after remand back proceeding vide order dated 30th January 2025 has confirmed the said demand of Rs. 55.5 crore (Tax Demand: - Rs. 27.75 crore + Penalty:- Rs. 27.75 crore plus interest, as may be applicable). Based on the advice of the tax consultant, the Company disagrees with the demand raised and accordingly has filed appeal before the CESTAT contesting the aforesaid demand order. Matter is pending to be listed before CESTAT for adjudication.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The Company has paid Service tax under Reverse Charge Mechanism on transactions with associated enterprises at the time of making payment. The department contested that company has violated the provisions of law by not discharging service tax liability at the time of accrual in its books of account. Accordingly, department has raised a demand of interest & penalty. The matter is pending before CESTAT for adjudication.
tax_litigation.status: Matter is pending to be listed before CESTAT for adjudication.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The Company had issued a recovery notice for its operational debt to Agson for an amount of Rs. 253,911,367.27/- in December 2021. In response, Agson invoked arbitration citing a preexisting dispute and has claimed an amount of Rs. 108,45,00,000 as damages under various heads. Currently, Arbitration proceedings are ongoing and the Company has also filed a counterclaim in the Arbitration matter initiated by Agson for Rs. 34,76,00,000/- (which includes amount of operational debt plus demurrage & other incurred costs). The matter is pending before the Sole Arbitrator for adjudication. Agson had been admitted into the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) by the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), New Delhi. IRP has been appointed in the matter , BASF has filed its claim with IRP , same has been included in contingent liability list by IRP

operating_notes.text: Coatings business generated sales of ₹595 crore for FY26 representing 4% of consolidated sales.
OMP is around 42% of sales with 25-30% gross margin; merchandise is 58% with 5-10% gross margin.
Celasto business represents around 10% of the performance materials operating division.
Agricultural Solutions has around 7% market share in India; 12 new products launched in last four years contribute 25% of ag division sales.
FY26 capacity utilisation was 82-87% overall, with Dahej in a similar range.
Own manufactured products were 42% of FY26 sales and merchandise 58%; exports were 2-2.5% of sales at ₹403 Cr.
Agri solutions market share is around 7%, up from 3% a few years back.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹3,443.87 Cr, net profit ₹68.88 Cr.

BASF India Limited’s Board of Directors, led by Manohar Kamath and Pankaj Bahl, recommended a final dividend of ₹25 per equity share (250%) for FY2025-26, pending shareholder approval at the AGM, payable from August 17, 2026.
22 May 2026: BASF India announced the NCLT-convened meeting of equity shareholders for June 24, 2026, regarding the Agricultural Solutions demerger.
BASF India hosted an analyst and fund manager meeting on May 22, 2026, providing updates on plant expansions and the ongoing demerger of its agricultural solutions and coatings businesses.
On 23 May 2026, BASF India informed the exchange about the availability of the recording of its analyst and fund managers meeting held on May 22, 2026.

BASF India held an analyst meeting on 22 May 2026, flagging feedstock inflation and demand softening, with Celasto line commissioning targeted by end-2026 and the Agricultural Solutions demerger shareholder meeting on 24 June 2026.

At its 82nd AGM on 12 August 2026, BASF India said the agri demerger's legal separation is set for January 2027 with a BASIL listing in H1 2027, and that the coatings sale to Carlyle closed on 30 June 2026 for about ₹230 Cr.

watchlist.response: Management did not address the agri margin history or the residual entity's portfolio in the closing answers; it cited delayed monsoons, portfolio expansion and market share rising to about 7% from 3%.
